## Source 1: School Rosters (Web Scraping)

What one row is: a Player on a team.

```{r fbs_scraper, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ---- Chrome for read_html_live() (Utah State, plus last-attempt retries) ----
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  chrome_path = file.path(Sys.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA"), "Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe")
  if (file.exists(chrome_path)) Sys.setenv(CHROMOTE_CHROME = chrome_path)
}
options(chromote.timeout = 60)

# ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Text of the first match inside each node (one value per node, NA if missing)
txt = function(nodes, css) rvest::html_text2(rvest::html_element(nodes, css))

# Same, but fill NAs using a fallback selector
txt2 = function(nodes, css, fallback) {
  x = txt(nodes, css)
  miss = is.na(x)
  if (any(miss)) x[miss] = txt(nodes[miss], fallback)
  x
}

# All matches on the page (for layouts that are scraped as parallel vectors)
txt_all = function(page, css) rvest::html_text2(rvest::html_elements(page, css))

debracket = function(x) stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove_all(x, "\\[|\\]"))

# Every text node inside one element, in order ("Year", "Redshirt Senior", "Height", ...)
text_tokens = function(node) {
  tok = stringr::str_squish(xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(node, ".//text()")))
  tok = stringr::str_remove(tok, ":$")
  tok[tok != ""]
}

LABELS = c("Position", "Academic Year", "Year", "Class", "Height", "Weight",
           "Hometown", "High School", "Previous School", "Last School")

# Value that follows a visible label; also handles "Label value" in one node
label_value = function(tok, labels) {
  for (lab in labels) {
    i = which(tok == lab)[1]
    if (!is.na(i) && i < length(tok) && !(tok[i + 1] %in% LABELS)) return(tok[i + 1])
    hit = tok[stringr::str_detect(tok, paste0("^", lab, "\\s"))]
    if (length(hit)) return(stringr::str_remove(hit[1], paste0("^", lab, "\\s*")))
  }
  NA_character_
}

# Label-based fields for a set of cards (layout-independent)
labeled_fields = function(cards) {
  rows = purrr::map(cards, function(card) {
    tok = text_tokens(card)
    list(tok      = tok,
         position = label_value(tok, "Position"),
         year     = label_value(tok, c("Academic Year", "Year", "Class")),
         height   = label_value(tok, "Height"),
         weight   = label_value(tok, "Weight"),
         hometown = label_value(tok, "Hometown"),
         prev     = label_value(tok, c("Previous School", "Last School")))
  })
  get = function(k) purrr::map_chr(rows, ~ .x[[k]])
  list(rows = rows, position = get("position"), year = get("year"), height = get("height"),
       weight = get("weight"), hometown = get("hometown"), prev = get("prev"))
}

# Height detection: any text shaped like 6' 2'', 6′2″, or 6-2
height_re = "^[4-7]\\s*(['′’]|-)\\s*\\d{1,2}(\\.\\d+|\\s*½|\\s+1/2)?\\s*(''|\"|″|”|’’)?$"

first_height = function(x) {
  x = stringr::str_remove(stringr::str_squish(x), "^(Height|Ht\\.?|HT)\\s*")
  x[stringr::str_detect(x, height_re)][1]
}

# Search every element in each card for a height-shaped value
find_height = function(cards) {
  purrr::map_chr(cards, ~ first_height(rvest::html_text2(rvest::html_elements(.x, "span, div, p, td, li"))))
}

# WMT card view (.roster-card-item, e.g. LSU): name -> height lookup
wmt_card_heights = function(page) {
  cc = rvest::html_elements(page, ".roster-card-item")
  if (length(cc) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(
    name = stringr::str_squish(txt2(cc, ".roster-card-item__title", "h3")),
    h    = purrr::map_chr(cc, ~ first_height(rvest::html_text2(
             rvest::html_elements(.x, ".roster-players-cards-item__profile-fields-wrapper span"))))
  )
}

# Build one standardized roster table (tibble errors loudly if lengths differ)
make_roster = function(name, year, position, height, weight, hometown, prev_school) {
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(dplyr::coalesce(hometown, ""), "^\\s*Hometown:?\\s*")
  home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  tibble::tibble(
    name            = name,
    year            = year,
    position        = position,
    height          = height,
    weight_lbs      = weight,
    hometown_city   = dplyr::na_if(stringr::str_squish(home[, 1]), ""),
    hometown_state  = dplyr::na_if(stringr::str_squish(home[, 2]), ""),
    previous_school = prev_school
  )
}

# ---- Parsers (one per site layout) ----------------------------------------

# Sidearm "nextgen" person cards (.s-person-card).
# Stats are matched by their label ("Height 6' 2''"), not by position, so a
# missing/extra stat no longer shifts every column.
parse_card = function(page) {
  cards = rvest::html_elements(page, ".s-person-card")
  if (length(cards) == 0) stop("no .s-person-card cards")

  items = purrr::map(cards, ~ stringr::str_squish(
    rvest::html_text2(rvest::html_elements(.x, ".s-person-details__bio-stats-item"))))
  by_label = function(re) purrr::map_chr(items, function(v) {
    hit = v[stringr::str_detect(v, re)]
    if (length(hit)) stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove(hit[1], re)) else NA_character_
  })
  position = by_label("^Position\\s*")
  year     = by_label("^(Academic Year|Year|Class)\\s*")
  height   = by_label("^Height\\s*")
  weight   = by_label("^Weight\\s*")

  # Only if the site has no labels at all, fall back to positional selectors
  if (!any(stringr::str_detect(unlist(items), "^(Position|Height|Weight)"))) {
    stat = function(i) txt(cards, paste0(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(", i, ")"))
    position = stat(1); year = stat(2); height = stat(3); weight = stat(4)
  }

  # JMU: height sits in the 4th stat's 2nd span; otherwise search the whole card
  if (any(is.na(height))) {
    jmu_h = txt(cards, ".s-person-details__bio-stats > span:nth-child(4) > span:nth-child(2)")
    jmu_h = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_squish(jmu_h), height_re), jmu_h, NA_character_)
    height = dplyr::coalesce(height, jmu_h, find_height(cards))
  }

  prev = txt(cards, ".s-person-card__content__person__previous-school-item") |>
    stringr::str_squish() |>
    stringr::str_remove("^.*:\\s*") |>
    stringr::str_remove("^Previous School(\\(s\\))?\\s*")

  make_roster(
    name = txt(cards, "h3"), position = position, year = year,
    height = height, weight = weight,
    hometown = txt(cards, ".s-person-card__content__person__location-item"),
    prev_school = prev
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(position))                           # drops coach/staff cards
}

# WMT list view (.roster-list-item); also handles the alternate field layout
# used by San Diego State / Washington State. Label-based values fill any gaps.
parse_list = function(page) {
  cards = rvest::html_elements(page, ".roster-list-item")
  if (length(cards) == 0) stop("no .roster-list-item cards")
  f = ".roster-player-list-profile-field--"
  a = ".roster-list-item__fields-item"
  use_alt = all(is.na(txt(cards, paste0(f, "position"))))
  sel = function(primary, alternative) if (use_alt) paste0(primary, ", ", alternative) else primary
  lab = labeled_fields(cards)

  prev = debracket(txt(cards, sel(paste0(f, "previous-school"), paste0(a, ":nth-child(2) > :nth-child(4)"))))
  prev = dplyr::coalesce(dplyr::na_if(prev, ""), lab$prev)
  prev = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(prev, "(HS|H\\.S\\.|High School|School|Academy|Prep)$"), NA_character_, prev)
  hs = debracket(txt(cards, paste0(f, "high-school")))
  college = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(hs, "/"),
                           stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove(hs, "^[^/]*/")),
                           NA_character_)
  prev = dplyr::if_else(is.na(prev) | prev == "", college, prev)

  out = make_roster(
    name     = txt(cards, sel(".roster-list-item__title", ".rosters-list-item__title-link")),
    position = dplyr::coalesce(debracket(txt(cards, sel(paste0(f, "position"),    paste0(a, ":nth-child(1) > :nth-child(1)")))), lab$position),
    year     = dplyr::coalesce(debracket(txt(cards, sel(paste0(f, "class-level"), paste0(a, ":nth-child(2) > :nth-child(1)")))), lab$year),
    height   = dplyr::coalesce(txt(cards, sel(paste0(f, "height > span"),         paste0(a, ":nth-child(1) > :nth-child(2)"))),
                               txt(cards, paste0(f, "height")), lab$height, find_height(cards)),
    weight   = dplyr::coalesce(debracket(txt(cards, sel(paste0(f, "weight"),      paste0(a, ":nth-child(1) > :nth-child(3)")))), lab$weight),
    hometown = dplyr::coalesce(debracket(txt(cards, sel(paste0(f, "hometown"),    paste0(a, ":nth-child(2) > :nth-child(2)")))), lab$hometown),
    prev_school = prev
  )

  # LSU: heights only appear in the card-view markup -> match to players by name
  if (all(is.na(out$height))) {
    ch = wmt_card_heights(page)
    if (!is.null(ch)) out$height = ch$h[match(stringr::str_squish(out$name), ch$name)]
  }

  dplyr::filter(out, !is.na(position))
}

# Penn State-style layout (.player-list-item): every field read by its label
parse_player_list = function(page) {
  cards = rvest::html_elements(page, ".player-list-item")
  if (length(cards) == 0) stop("no .player-list-item cards")
  lab = labeled_fields(cards)

  pos_re = paste0("^(QB|RB|FB|WR|TE|OL|OT|OG|C|DL|DT|DE|NT|EDGE|LB|ILB|OLB|DB|CB|S|SAF|NB|K|P|PK|LS|ATH|",
                  "(Offensive|Defensive|Wide|Running|Tight|Long|Place|Outside|Inside)\\s.*|",
                  "Quarterback|Linebacker|Safety|Cornerback|Kicker|Punter|Fullback|Center|Athlete)$")
  unlabeled_pos = purrr::map_chr(lab$rows, ~ .x$tok[stringr::str_detect(.x$tok, pos_re)][1])

  make_roster(
    name = txt2(cards, ".player-list-item__heading h3 a", "h3"),
    position = dplyr::coalesce(lab$position, unlabeled_pos),
    year = lab$year, height = dplyr::coalesce(lab$height, find_height(cards)), weight = lab$weight,
    hometown = lab$hometown, prev_school = lab$prev
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), !(is.na(year) & is.na(height)))   # drops staff without needing a position
}

# Sidearm classic (.sidearm-roster-player). pos_mode covers per-school differences.
parse_sidearm = function(page,
                         pos_mode = c("last", "raw", "drop_last"),
                         pos_css  = ".sidearm-roster-player-position .text-bold",
                         year_css = ".sidearm-roster-player-academic-year") {
  pos_mode = match.arg(pos_mode)
  cards = rvest::html_elements(page, ".sidearm-roster-player")
  pos = stringr::str_squish(txt(cards, pos_css))
  pos = switch(pos_mode,
               last      = stringr::str_extract(pos, "\\S+$"),
               drop_last = stringr::str_remove(pos, "\\s+\\S+$"),
               raw       = pos)
  make_roster(
    name = stringr::str_squish(txt2(cards, ".sidearm-roster-player-name h3 a", ".sidearm-roster-player-name h3")),
    position = pos,
    year     = txt(cards, year_css),
    height   = txt(cards, ".sidearm-roster-player-height"),
    weight   = txt(cards, ".sidearm-roster-player-weight"),
    hometown = txt(cards, ".sidearm-roster-player-hometown"),
    prev_school = txt(cards, ".sidearm-roster-player-previous-school")
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), name != "")
}

# WMT table view (UTSA, Old Dominion) - row by row
parse_wmt_table = function(page) {
  rows = rvest::html_elements(page, "tr")
  cell = function(cls) txt(rows, paste0(".roster-table-cell--", cls, " > span"))
  make_roster(
    name = txt2(rows, "th > div > a > span", "th a"),
    position = cell("player-position-name"), year = cell("class-level-name"),
    height = cell("height-text"), weight = cell("weight-text"),
    hometown = cell("hometown"), prev_school = cell("previous-school")
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), !is.na(position))
}

parse_notre_dame = function(page) {
  rows = rvest::html_elements(page, "tr")
  td = function(i, span = FALSE) txt(rows, paste0("td:nth-child(", i, ")", if (span) " > span" else ""))
  make_roster(
    name = txt2(rows, "th > div > a > span", "th a"),
    position = td(3, TRUE), height = td(4, TRUE), weight = td(5, TRUE),
    year = td(6), hometown = td(7),
    prev_school = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_extract(td(8), "(?<=/).*$"))
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), !is.na(position))
}

parse_kentucky = function(page) {
  rows = rvest::html_elements(page, "tr")
  td = function(i) txt(rows, paste0("td:nth-child(", i, ")"))
  make_roster(
    name = txt(rows, "td:nth-child(2) > a"),
    position = td(3), height = td(4), weight = td(5), year = td(6),
    hometown = td(7), prev_school = td(9)
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name))
}

parse_south_carolina = function(page) {
  hometown = txt_all(page, "td.hometown")
  n = seq_along(hometown)                                     # one table row per player
  info = stringr::str_split_fixed(txt_all(page, "div > p.info")[n], "\\s*/\\s*", n = 3)
  make_roster(
    name = txt_all(page, "h3 > div > a")[n],
    position = txt_all(page, "div > span.position")[n],
    height = info[, 1], weight = info[, 2], year = info[, 3],
    hometown = hometown,
    prev_school = txt_all(page, "td.previousschool")
  )
}

parse_navy = function(page) {
  rows = rvest::html_elements(page, "tr")
  make_roster(
    name = txt(rows, ".sidearm-table-player-name > a"),
    position = txt(rows, ".rp_position_short"),
    year = txt(rows, ".roster_class"),
    height = txt(rows, ".height"),
    weight = txt(rows, ".rp_weight"),
    hometown = stringr::str_remove(txt(rows, ".hometownhighschool"), "\\s*(/|\\n).*$"),
    prev_school = NA_character_                               # not listed on Navy's roster
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name))
}

parse_utah_state = function(page) {
  make_roster(
    name = txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-player-name > a"),
    position = txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-list-item-position"),
    year = txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-list-item-year"),
    height = txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-list-item-height") |>
      stringr::str_remove_all("\"| ") |>
      stringr::str_replace("'", "-"),
    weight = txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-list-item-weight"),
    hometown = txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-list-item-hometown"),
    prev_school = stringr::str_squish(
      stringr::str_extract(txt_all(page, ".sidearm-roster-list-item-highschool"), "(?<=/).*$")
    )
  )
}

# Last resort: any HTML <table> with a Name column
parse_generic_table = function(page) {
  tables = rvest::html_table(page)
  tables = purrr::keep(tables, ~ nrow(.x) > 20 && any(stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(.x)), "name")))
  if (length(tables) == 0) stop("no roster table found")
  tb = tables[[which.max(purrr::map_int(tables, nrow))]]
  col = function(pattern) {
    i = which(stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(tb)), pattern))[1]
    if (is.na(i)) NA_character_ else as.character(tb[[i]])
  }
  make_roster(
    name = col("name"), position = col("^pos"),
    year = col("^(cl|class|yr|year|elig|academic)"),
    height = col("^(ht|height)"), weight = col("^(wt|weight)"),
    hometown = col("hometown"), prev_school = col("previous|last school")
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), name != "")
}

parsers = list(
  card           = parse_card,
  list           = parse_list,
  player_list    = parse_player_list,
  sidearm        = function(p) parse_sidearm(p, pos_mode = "last"),
  sidearm_raw    = function(p) parse_sidearm(p, pos_mode = "raw"),
  sidearm_plain  = function(p) parse_sidearm(p, pos_mode = "raw", pos_css = ".sidearm-roster-player-position"),
  sidearm_txst   = function(p) parse_sidearm(p, pos_mode = "drop_last", year_css = ".sidearm-roster-player-custom1"),
  wmt_table      = parse_wmt_table,
  notre_dame     = parse_notre_dame,
  kentucky       = parse_kentucky,
  south_carolina = parse_south_carolina,
  navy           = parse_navy,
  utah_state     = parse_utah_state,
  generic_table  = parse_generic_table
)

# Try every known layout until one returns players
parse_auto = function(page) {
  for (p in c("card", "list", "player_list", "sidearm", "wmt_table", "generic_table")) {
    out = tryCatch(parsers[[p]](page), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(out) && nrow(out) > 0) return(out)
  }
  stop("no known roster layout matched")
}

# Quick test: uncomment to run just a few schools before the full ~10+ minute run
# schools = dplyr::filter(schools, school %in% c("LSU", "James Madison"))

# ---- Scrape one school: assigned parser -> auto-detect -> retry ------------
# Pages filled in by JavaScript are loaded through Chrome: always for
# live_parsers, and as a last-attempt fallback for every other school.
live_parsers = c("utah_state")

fetch_and_parse = function(url, parser, live = FALSE) {
  page = if (live) rvest::read_html_live(url) else rvest::read_html(url)
  if (live) {
    on.exit(try(page$session$close(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)
    Sys.sleep(5)
  }
  out = tryCatch(parsers[[parser]](page), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out) || nrow(out) == 0) out = parse_auto(page)
  out
}

scrape_school = function(school, conference, url, parser, tries = 3) {
  for (attempt in seq_len(tries)) {
    live = parser %in% live_parsers || attempt == tries
    out = tryCatch(fetch_and_parse(url, parser, live), error = function(e) {
      message("  ", school, " (attempt ", attempt, if (live) ", live" else "", "): ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(out) && nrow(out) > 0) {
      message(sprintf("%-20s %-16s %3d players", school, conference, nrow(out)))
      return(dplyr::mutate(out, school = school, conference = conference, .before = 1))
    }
    Sys.sleep(3 * attempt)
  }
  warning(school, " could not be scraped: ", url, call. = FALSE)
  NULL
}

# ---- Run everything --------------------------------------------------------
hs_pattern = "(\\bHS|H\\.S\\.|High School|Academy|Prep)$"

fbs_rosters = purrr::pmap(schools, function(school, conference, url, parser) {
  res = scrape_school(school, conference, url, parser)
  Sys.sleep(2)
  res
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(tidyselect::everything(),
                  ~ stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove_all(as.character(.x), "\\[|\\]"))),

    # Position: strip labels, captain tags, and stats glued onto the position
    position = position |>
      stringr::str_remove("^Position\\s*") |>
      stringr::str_remove("\\s*Is Captain \\(C\\)$") |>
      stringr::str_remove("\\s+\\d.*$"),                       # "WR 5'11\" 195 lbs ..." -> "WR"
    position = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(position, "[a-z].*\\s[A-Z/]{1,6}$"),
                              stringr::str_extract(position, "[A-Z/]{1,6}$"),   # "Defensive Back DB" -> "DB"
                              position),
    position = stringr::str_replace(position, "^(\\S+) \\1$", "\\1"),          # "OL OL" -> "OL"

    year   = stringr::str_remove(year, "^(Academic Year|Year|Class)\\s*"),
    height = stringr::str_remove(height, "^(Height|Ht\\.?|HT)\\s*"),
    height = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(height, "^\\d"), height, NA_character_),

    # Height in inches from any format (6' 2'', 6′2″, 6-2, 6'2")
    height_in = {
      m = stringr::str_match(height, "^(\\d)\\D+(\\d{1,2}(?:\\.\\d+)?)")
      as.numeric(m[, 2]) * 12 + as.numeric(m[, 3]) + dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(height, "½|1/2"), 0.5, 0)
    },

    weight_lbs = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(weight_lbs, "\\d+"))),
    weight_lbs = dplyr::if_else(weight_lbs >= 120 & weight_lbs <= 450, weight_lbs, NA_real_),

    # Previous school: colleges only
    previous_school = dplyr::if_else(school == "Arkansas",       # Arkansas lists "High School / College"
                                     stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_extract(previous_school, "(?<=/).*$")),
                                     previous_school),
    previous_school = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(previous_school, hs_pattern),
                                     NA_character_, previous_school),

    dplyr::across(tidyselect::where(is.character), ~ dplyr::na_if(.x, ""))
  ) |>
  # Drop non-players: Team IMPACT members, memorial cards, honorary captains
  dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(name, "^In Memory"),
                is.na(position) | !position %in% c("IMPACT", "Team IMPACT", "Captain")) |>
  dplyr::relocate(height_in, .after = height)

# ---- Validation: did every team come through cleanly? ----------------------
school_summary = fbs_rosters |>
  dplyr::group_by(conference, school) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    players         = dplyr::n(),
    pct_na_position = round(mean(is.na(position)) * 100),
    pct_na_year     = round(mean(is.na(year)) * 100),
    pct_na_height   = round(mean(is.na(height_in)) * 100),
    pct_na_weight   = round(mean(is.na(weight_lbs)) * 100),
    pct_na_hometown = round(mean(is.na(hometown_city)) * 100),
    long_positions  = sum(nchar(position) > 20, na.rm = TRUE),  # catches merged text
    .groups = "drop"
  )

missing_schools = setdiff(schools$school, school_summary$school)
suspicious = school_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(players < 70 | players > 200 |
                  pct_na_position > 10 | pct_na_year > 10 |
                  pct_na_height > 10 | pct_na_weight > 10 |
                  pct_na_hometown > 25 | long_positions > 0)

if (length(missing_schools) > 0) {
  warning("NOT scraped: ", paste(missing_schools, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
} else {
  message("All ", nrow(schools), " schools scraped (", nrow(fbs_rosters), " players).")
}
if (nrow(suspicious) > 0) {
  message("Check these schools:")
  print(suspicious, n = Inf)
}

print(dplyr::count(fbs_rosters, conference))
```

## Source 2: American Community Survey (API)

What one row is: One U.S. Census geographic area (place or county), containing socioeconomic characteristics, geographic coordinates, and county-matching information where applicable.

```{r census_api}
# CENSUS DATA SETUP
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(here)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Store the final consolidated CSV in the project's raw data folder
census_output_dir <- here("data", "raw")

dir.create(
  census_output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Use 2024 ACS 5-year estimates for consistency
census_year <- 2024

# Exclude Puerto Rico; retain 50 states and Washington, DC
census_states <- c(state.abb, "DC")

# Define variables shared by places and counties
census_variables <- c(
  median_income = "B19013_001",
  population = "B01003_001",
  poverty_total = "B17001_001",
  poverty_count = "B17001_002"
)

# Confirm the Census API key is available
if (Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY") == "") {
  stop("Census API key not found. Check your .Renviron file.")
}

# NATIONWIDE CENSUS PLACE DATA

# Retrieve ACS data for all 50 states and Washington, DC
census_places <- purrr::map_dfr(
  census_states,
  function(st) {

    message("Retrieving Census places for: ", st)

    state_data <- get_acs(
      geography = "place",
      variables = census_variables,
      state = st,
      year = census_year,
      survey = "acs5",
      output = "wide"
    )

    state_data %>%
      mutate(state_abbr = st)
  }
)

# Calculate poverty rate
census_places <- census_places %>%
  mutate(
    poverty_rate = if_else(
      poverty_totalE > 0,
      poverty_countE / poverty_totalE * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Check the results
dim(census_places)

census_places %>%
  count(state_abbr, sort = TRUE)



# CENSUS PLACE GEOGRAPHIC COORDINATES

# Retrieve 2024 Census place boundaries
place_boundaries <- tigris::places(
  year = census_year,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep the same Census places returned by the ACS API
place_boundaries <- place_boundaries %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% census_places$GEOID)

# Calculate representative points in a projected coordinate system
place_points <- place_boundaries %>%
  st_transform(6933) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Extract longitude and latitude
place_coords <- st_coordinates(place_points)

place_geography <- place_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    GEOID,
    longitude = place_coords[, 1],
    latitude = place_coords[, 2]
  )

# Join coordinates to socioeconomic data
census_places <- census_places %>%
  left_join(place_geography, by = "GEOID")

# Validate geographic coverage
census_places %>%
  summarise(
    total_places = n(),
    missing_coordinates = sum(is.na(longitude) | is.na(latitude)),
    duplicate_geoids = sum(duplicated(GEOID))
  )



# NATIONWIDE COUNTY CENSUS DATA

# Add education variables to the county Census request
county_variables <- c(
  census_variables,
  education_total = "B15003_001",
  bachelors = "B15003_022",
  masters = "B15003_023",
  professional = "B15003_024",
  doctorate = "B15003_025"
)

# Retrieve 2024 ACS 5-year estimates for U.S. counties
census_counties <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = county_variables,
  year = census_year,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide"
)

# Exclude Puerto Rico and calculate socioeconomic percentages
census_counties <- census_counties %>%
  filter(substr(GEOID, 1, 2) != "72") %>%
  mutate(
    poverty_rate = if_else(
      poverty_totalE > 0,
      poverty_countE / poverty_totalE * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    bachelors_or_higher = if_else(
      education_totalE > 0,
      (bachelorsE + mastersE + professionalE + doctorateE) /
        education_totalE * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Validate county acquisition
census_counties %>%
  summarise(
    total_counties = n(),
    duplicate_geoids = sum(duplicated(GEOID)),
    missing_population = sum(is.na(populationE)),
    missing_income = sum(is.na(median_incomeE))
  )


# COUNTY GEOGRAPHIC COORDINATES AND POPULATION DENSITY

# Retrieve 2024 county boundaries
county_boundaries <- tigris::counties(
  year = census_year,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep the same counties included in our ACS dataset
county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% census_counties$GEOID)

# Calculate county land area in square miles
county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  mutate(
    land_area_sqmi = as.numeric(ALAND) / 2589988.110336
  )

# Generate representative county points
county_points <- county_boundaries %>%
  st_transform(6933) %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Extract longitude and latitude
county_coords <- st_coordinates(county_points)

county_geography <- county_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    GEOID,
    longitude = county_coords[, 1],
    latitude = county_coords[, 2],
    land_area_sqmi
  )

# Join geographic characteristics to county Census data
census_counties <- census_counties %>%
  left_join(county_geography, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    population_density = if_else(
      land_area_sqmi > 0,
      populationE / land_area_sqmi,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Validate geographic coverage
census_counties %>%
  summarise(
    total_counties = n(),
    missing_coordinates = sum(is.na(longitude) | is.na(latitude)),
    missing_land_area = sum(is.na(land_area_sqmi)),
    missing_density = sum(is.na(population_density)),
    duplicate_geoids = sum(duplicated(GEOID))
  )


# CITY-TO-COUNTY GEOGRAPHIC MATCHING

# Prepare place and county boundaries in the same projection
city_boundaries <- place_boundaries %>%
  select(city_geoid = GEOID, city_name = NAME) %>%
  st_transform(6933)

county_match_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  select(county_geoid = GEOID, county_name = NAME) %>%
  st_transform(6933)

# Generate a representative point inside each Census place
city_points <- st_point_on_surface(city_boundaries)

# Assign each place to the county containing its representative point
city_county_lookup <- st_join(
  city_points,
  county_match_boundaries,
  join = st_within,
  left = TRUE
) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    city_geoid,
    city_name,
    county_geoid,
    county_name
  )

# Identify places that span multiple counties
county_overlaps <- st_relate(
  city_boundaries,
  county_match_boundaries,
  pattern = "T********"
)

county_counts <- tibble(
  city_geoid = city_boundaries$city_geoid,
  county_count = lengths(county_overlaps)
)

# Add county ambiguity indicators
city_county_lookup <- city_county_lookup %>%
  left_join(county_counts, by = "city_geoid") %>%
  mutate(
    multiple_counties = county_count > 1,
    county_match_status = if_else(
      multiple_counties,
      "Requires county verification",
      "Single-county match"
    )
  )

# Validate city-to-county matching
city_county_lookup %>%
  summarise(
    total_places = n(),
    missing_counties = sum(is.na(county_geoid)),
    duplicate_cities = sum(duplicated(city_geoid)),
    single_county_places = sum(!multiple_counties),
    multi_county_places = sum(multiple_counties)
  )


# CONSOLIDATE CENSUS PLACES AND COUNTIES

# Standardize place-level data
census_places_final <- census_places %>%
  left_join(
    city_county_lookup %>%
      select(
        city_geoid,
        county_geoid,
        county_name,
        county_count,
        multiple_counties,
        county_match_status
      ),
    by = c("GEOID" = "city_geoid")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    geography_level = "place",
    geoid = GEOID,
    name = NAME,
    state_abbr,
    population = populationE,
    median_income = median_incomeE,
    poverty_rate,
    bachelors_or_higher = NA_real_,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    land_area_sqmi = NA_real_,
    population_density = NA_real_,
    county_geoid,
    county_name,
    county_count,
    multiple_counties,
    county_match_status
  )

# Standardize county-level data
census_counties_final <- census_counties %>%
  transmute(
    geography_level = "county",
    geoid = GEOID,
    name = NAME,
    state_abbr = NA_character_,
    population = populationE,
    median_income = median_incomeE,
    poverty_rate,
    bachelors_or_higher,
    longitude,
    latitude,
    land_area_sqmi,
    population_density,
    county_geoid = GEOID,
    county_name = NAME,
    county_count = NA_integer_,
    multiple_counties = NA,
    county_match_status = NA_character_
  )

# Combine both geography levels
census_geography <- bind_rows(
  census_places_final,
  census_counties_final
)

# Validate combined dataset
census_geography %>%
  count(geography_level)

census_geography %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    missing_coordinates = sum(is.na(longitude) | is.na(latitude)),
    duplicate_geographies = sum(
      duplicated(paste(geography_level, geoid))
    )
  )

# Save one consolidated CSV
write_csv(
  census_geography,
  file.path(census_output_dir, "census_geography_2024.csv")
)
```

## Source 3: collegefootballdata.com (API)

What one row is: a player for a season, with columns for player statistic, one column per statistic.

```{r}
get_cfbd_data = function(endpoint, query_params = list()) {
  api_key = Sys.getenv("CFBD_API_KEY")
  if (api_key == "") stop("CFBD_API_KEY environment variable is not set. Check your .Renviron.")

  httr2::request(paste0("https://api.collegefootballdata.com", endpoint)) |>
    httr2::req_headers(
      Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
      Accept        = "application/json"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_url_query(!!!query_params) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 2) |>   # retries if rate-limited or dropped
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)        # JSON -> data frame
}

target_years = 2026

# One row = one player, one column per stat (e.g. passing_yds, rushing_td)
cfbd_player_stats = purrr::map(target_years, function(yr) {
  get_cfbd_data("/stats/player/season", list(year = yr)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(season = yr)
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    stat_name = stringr::str_to_lower(paste(category, statType, sep = "_")) |>
      stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_"),
    stat = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stat))
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = tidyselect::any_of(c("season", "playerId", "player", "team", "conference", "position")),
    names_from  = stat_name,
    values_from = stat,
    values_fn   = dplyr::first    # guards against rare duplicate rows
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(name = player, school = team, player_id = playerId) |>
  dplyr::relocate(school, conference, name, position, .after = season) |>
  dplyr::arrange(conference, school, name)

message(nrow(cfbd_player_stats), " players, ", ncol(cfbd_player_stats), " columns")
dplyr::glimpse(cfbd_player_stats)
```

## Save the raw data

```{r}
raw_dir = "../data/raw"

write.csv(fbs_rosters,
          file.path(raw_dir, "fbs_rosters.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cfbd_player_stats,
          file.path(raw_dir, "cfbd_player_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
